text:
evan: Quick interrupt — Willow the office otter insists on towel diplomacy today. She put a tiny towel on the conference chair and will only accept agenda items in exchange for belly rubs. Photo: https://imgur.com/a/willow-towel :otter: :towel:
maya: Iconic. is the towel color-coordinated with our sprint board? :sparkles: also what is her rate for agenda approvals? :money_with_wings:
tess: She charges one squeaky toy per minute of meeting silence. Works best with natural light. Camera: `iPhone SE, Live Photo` + a dramatic side-eye crop. :camera:
ev an: (typo) evan: She also brought her own tiny lifebuoy. we are not allowed to remove it. :life_buoy::joy:
ops-bot: Reminder: Please supervise pets in common areas and consult Facilities for allergies. See https://intranet/company/pets-policy :information_source:
sanjay: Can confirm morale metric went up 12% during her towel tenure. requesting a formal "Willow Wednesday" pilot program. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maya: Proposal: every meeting with Willow gets one extra 5-minute snack break. vote with :otter: (yes) or :no_entry_sign: (no). so far: evan :otter:, tess :otter:, maya :otter:.
tess: Also note: Willow will only snooze on keyboards that are in Do Not Disturb mode. Please toggle DND if you want to keep your keyboard crumb-free. :zzz:
evan: Tiny logistics: if you want to pet Willow, ask first. She has a strict "no surprises" policy. snacks preferred: dried fish bits or tiny grapes (no chocolate). :fish::grapes:
sanjay: Merch idea: tiny towels with the company logo and "Willow Approved" stitched on. who wants prototypes? :raised_hands:
maya: me. ordering 3 for my home office. can we make one with a pocket for USB keys? :thumbsup:
tess: I'm starting a sticker sheet: "Willow Says: Good Job" and "Do Not Disturb: Otter Napping." will drop proofs in #design later. :sticker:
ops-bot: Facilities note acknowledged. Please wipe seats after pet visits and store towels in the shared bin when not in use.
